mapper.select: SELECT q.id,q.owner_id,v.id AS version_id,current_version.id AS current_version_id,q.status, SHA2(CONCAT(SHA2(CAST(CONVERT(v.prompt_json USING utf8mb4) AS BINARY),256), SHA2(CAST(CONVERT(v.reference_answer USING utf8mb4) AS BINARY),256), SHA2(CAST(CONVERT(v.checkpoints_json USING utf8mb4) AS BINARY),256)),256) AS source_content_hash, (#{checkpointId} IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(v.checkpoints_json,'$[*]' COLUMNS (checkpoint_id CHAR(36) PATH '$.id' ERROR ON ERROR)) cp WHERE CAST(cp.checkpoint_id AS BINARY)=CAST(#{checkpointId} AS BINARY))) AS checkpoint_present, stamp.source_content_hash AS sealed_content_hash,stamp.fingerprint,stamp.created_at AS sealed_at FROM question q JOIN question_version v ON v.owner_id=q.owner_id AND v.question_id=q.id AND v.id=#{versionId} LEFT JOIN question_version current_version ON current_version.owner_id=q.owner_id AND current_version.question_id=q.id AND current_version.id=q.current_version_id LEFT JOIN review_question_projection_stamp stamp ON stamp.owner_id=q.owner_id AND stamp.question_id=q.id AND stamp.version_id=v.id WHERE q.owner_id=#{owner} AND q.id=#{id}

select.foreach: SELECT #{request.evidenceId} AS evidence_id,i.id,i.owner_id,i.kind,i.status, current_version.id AS current_version_id,v.id AS version_id, SHA2(CAST(CONVERT(current_version.body USING utf8mb4) AS BINARY),256) AS current_fingerprint, IF(v.id IS NOT NULL AND #{request.start} >= 0 AND #{request.end} > #{request.start} AND OCTET_LENGTH(CONVERT(v.body USING utf16)) >= #{request.end} * 2 AND SUBSTRING(CAST(CONVERT(v.body USING utf16) AS BINARY),#{request.start} * 2 + 1, (#{request.end} - #{request.start}) * 2)=CAST(CONVERT(#{request.quote} USING utf16) AS BINARY),TRUE,FALSE) AS quote_matches FROM knowledge_item i LEFT JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.id AND v.id=#{request.versionId} LEFT JOIN knowledge_version current_version ON current_version.owner_id=i.owner_id AND current_version.item_id=i.id AND current_version.id=i.current_version_id WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.id=#{request.itemId}

SELECT #{request.evidenceId} AS evidence_id,e.id AS excerpt_id,e.owner_id,e.attachment_id, a.status AS attachment_status,a.sha256 AS attachment_fingerprint, IF(a.id IS NOT NULL AND a.status='READY' AND a.sha256=e.attachment_sha256 AND ( (e.origin='MANUAL' AND e.run_id IS NULL AND e.segment_id IS NULL AND e.start_offset IS NULL AND e.end_offset IS NULL) OR (e.origin='PARSED' AND r.id IS NOT NULL AND r.status='SUCCEEDED' AND r.attachment_sha256=a.sha256 AND s.id IS NOT NULL AND CAST(e.locator AS BINARY)=CAST(s.locator AS BINARY) AND e.start_offset >= 0 AND e.end_offset > e.start_offset AND OCTET_LENGTH(CONVERT(s.text USING utf16)) >= e.end_offset * 2 AND SUBSTRING(CAST(CONVERT(s.text USING utf16) AS BINARY),e.start_offset * 2 + 1, (e.end_offset - e.start_offset) * 2)=CAST(CONVERT(e.text USING utf16) AS BINARY))),TRUE,FALSE) AS chain_valid, IF(#{request.start} >= 0 AND #{request.end} > #{request.start} AND OCTET_LENGTH(CONVERT(e.text USING utf16)) >= #{request.end} * 2 AND SUBSTRING(CAST(CONVERT(e.text USING utf16) AS BINARY),#{request.start} * 2 + 1, (#{request.end} - #{request.start}) * 2)=CAST(CONVERT(#{request.quote} USING utf16) AS BINARY),TRUE,FALSE) AS quote_matches FROM material_excerpt e LEFT JOIN material_attachment a ON a.owner_id=e.owner_id AND a.id=e.attachment_id LEFT JOIN material_parse_run r ON r.owner_id=e.owner_id AND r.attachment_id=e.attachment_id AND r.id=e.run_id LEFT JOIN material_segment s ON s.owner_id=e.owner_id AND s.attachment_id=e.attachment_id AND s.run_id=e.run_id AND s.id=e.segment_id WHERE e.owner_id=#{owner} AND e.id=#{request.excerptId}
